BackstoryDef.title: Institute-Raised
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised entirely within the Institute, educated by its best instructors and shielded from the surface [PAWN_pronoun] was told wasn't worth seeing. [PAWN_pronoun] absorbed its priorities before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to question them.

BackstoryDef.title: Director of the Institute
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] holds the Institute's highest office, weighing every division head's proposal against a single standard: does it move the organization's work forward. [PAWN_pronoun] frames every decision, including the difficult ones, as necessary progress rather than choice.

BackstoryDef.title: Prodigy Engineer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] showed an aptitude for reactor design and applied physics well ahead of [PAWN_possessive] peers, and the Institute's instructors made sure that aptitude was put to use immediately.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Advanced Systems
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs Advanced Systems, overseeing the Institute's reactor and synth-chassis research with an exactness that leaves little tolerance for error. [PAWN_pronoun] left a promising career on the surface for the certainty of unlimited resources and no oversight but [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: Security Track Recruit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was selected early for the Institute's internal security track, trained to treat containment breaches and surface leaks as the same category of problem: solvable, given the right procedure.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of the Synth Retention Bureau
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the Synth Retention Bureau and functions as the Institute's closest thing to a military commander, authorizing courser deployments to retrieve or eliminate synths that stop following orders. [PAWN_pronoun] treats every escaped unit as an open file, not a person.

BackstoryDef.title: SRB Cadet
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] trained under the Synth Retention Bureau's field program, learning to run surface retrieval operations with minimal exposure and minimal questions asked afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: SRB Field Officer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the Synth Retention Bureau's surface recovery operations, coordinating courser teams and reporting directly to Ayo. [PAWN_pronoun] spends more time above ground than almost anyone else in the Institute and trusts the surface for it even less than [PAWN_possessive] superiors do.

BackstoryDef.title: Bioscience Track Student
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized early in the Institute's biological sciences curriculum, drawn to questions of adaptation and survival that the surface answered the hard way and the Institute preferred to answer in a controlled setting.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of BioScience
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads BioScience, overseeing research into radiation resistance, FEV, and biological weapons applications with the same procedural detachment [PAWN_pronoun] brings to everything else. Colleagues describe [PAWN_objective] as thorough. None describe [PAWN_objective] as warm.

BackstoryDef.title: Robotics Track Apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] apprenticed in the Institute's robotics division, working through chassis designs and synthetic musculature schematics years before [PAWN_pronoun] was permitted anywhere near a live unit.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Robotics
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads the Robotics division and is credited within the Institute as the principal architect of the third-generation synth line. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks about the units [PAWN_pronoun] designed the way an engineer speaks about a bridge - proud of the specifications, uninterested in whether the bridge has opinions.
